definition: Query understanding is the process of inferring the intent of a search engine user by extracting semantic meaning from the searcher’s keywords.
details: Query understanding methods generally take place before the search engine retrieves and ranks results. It is related to natural language processing but specifically focused on the understanding of search queries.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. Boil it down and it is this: Query understanding is the process of inferring the intent of a search engine user by extracting semantic meaning from the searcher’s keywords. Here is why it matters: Query understanding methods generally take place before the search engine retrieves and ranks results. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. That pattern-earned fluency is Query understanding.
